additions.name: GDS (Wanguo Data) Zhongwei Integrated Green Advanced Demonstration Data Center Industrial Park — A-Zone Phase 1

status.summary: On 30 September 2026 the Zhongwei Natural Resources Bureau issued the construction-project planning permit (electronic supervision no. 6405022026GG0074699) to Ningxia Wanguo Yunning Data Technology Co., Ltd. for A-zone Phase 1 of the Wanguo Data Zhongwei Integrated Green Advanced Demonstration Data Center Industrial Park at Xuanhe Town (179,752.78 m2 GFA), published as in effect on 10 October 2026. The 18 September scheme provides machine-room buildings, diesel-generator buildings and a 330 kV substation on 15.3235 ha. No construction start, completion or operation is established; Phase 2 (permit 6405022026GG0075620, same day) is separate scope.
status.permit_reference: Zhongwei Natural Resources Bureau construction-project planning permit, electronic supervision no. 6405022026GG0074699, issued 2026-09-30 (post-issuance notice index 640501011/2026-00796, 2026-10-10); preceded by land-use planning permit 6405022026YG0025654 issued 2026-09-23 for the same real-estate unit 640502105212GB00038W00000000
status.permit_identity_review: The permit names 万国数据中卫一体化绿色先进示范数据中心产业园A区一期项目 with Ningxia Wanguo Yunning Data Technology Co., Ltd. as builder, at Xuanhe Town bounded east by Sandang Highway, south by Weiliu Road and north by the A-zone Phase 2 land; its GFA (179,752.78 m2) and builder match the 18 September Phase 1 scheme board (machine-room and diesel-generator buildings, 330 kV substation, 15.3235 ha). A construction-project planning permit authorises the building works of the data-centre development itself. It is in effect (validity marked effective); no suspension or appeal was found.

locator.precision: Area centroid of the one parcel on the official Xuanhe detailed-plan land-use map bounded by Jingsan Road (west), Wanyun Road (north), the Sandang Highway corridor (east) and Weiliu Road (south), which the A-zone Phase 1 (south half, to Weiliu Road) and Phase 2 (north half, to Wanyun Road) permits jointly describe. The map raster (about 6.5 m per px) is registered to Esri World Imagery with 140 patch controls (about 5 m RMS image-to-image). Locates the two-phase A-zone campus; not the Phase 1 half, a building footprint, entrance, surveyed boundary or construction extent. The traced parcel is 29.91 ha with vertices up to about 400 m from the point.
locator.identity_review: The Phase 1 permit bounds the land by Sandang Highway (east) and Weiliu Road (south) with Phase 2 to the north; the Phase 2 permit bounds it by Sandang Highway (east) and Wanyun Road (north). On the 20 August 2026 official Xuanhe detailed plan, Wanyun Road runs only between Jingsan Road and Sandang Highway, and exactly one parcel lies south of it, north of Weiliu Road and west of Sandang Highway. Its traced area (29.91 ha) matches Phase 1 plus Phase 2 (15.32 + 14.68 = 30.00 ha) within 0.3%, and its mid-line halves (15.38 / 14.53 ha) match the phases. The Phase 1 board (1:1000, north-up) independently shows 纬六路 on the south red line and an 8 m planned branch road (Wanyun Road is the plan's 8 m secondary road) on the north red line. The two real-estate units (GB00038W, GB00039W) are consecutive in cadastral zone 640502105212, the zone of the China Mobile Xuanhe campus permits. As a check of the registration, the official Zhonglian Xuanhe and CIDC Xuanhe 330 kV and China Mobile D-zone 110 kV EIA station points, read as WGS84, fall on or beside data-centre parcels of the registered map. The operator link to GDS rests on the official project name (万国数据, GDS's Chinese trade name); the builders are project companies named Ningxia Wanguo Yunning and Ningxia Wanguo Shuwei, and no GDS filing naming this campus was found.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The plan publishes no coordinates, datum or survey accuracy: the point rests on a 6.5 m per px planning raster registered to Esri World Imagery whose acquisition date and absolute accuracy are not stated. Registration residuals (about 5 m RMS, 15.5 m max; 27 m when extrapolating from the north half to the south half) measure only the image-to-image fit; manual parcel tracing adds about 1 px. Estimated within roughly 50 m of the parcel centroid; decimal places are arithmetic precision. Buildings may lie up to about 400 m from the point.

No GDS, Wanguo or A-zone record exists; the only keyword hits are the three thirty-fourth Zhongwei sites and the thirty-fourth hold for this candidate (now resolved). One Atlas record lies within 2 km: China Mobile (Ningxia Zhongwei) Data Center Xuanhe Campus (D07-D10 project), 1,957 m east-north-east, a different operator on a different parcel east of Sandang Highway. Other records within about 2 km: the Volcano Engine Xuanhe Compute Centre Phase 1 parcel added in this same fragment, 745 m north-north-east (a different builder on parcel 卫地(G)[2026]-29 at the Weisi Road/Sandang Highway corner, north of Wanyun Road), the held Zhonglian Zero-Carbon (Xuanhe) A-zone substation point 757 m north-east (different builder, east of Sandang Highway), the CIDC Xuanhe 330 kV lead point 2.02 km north-east, and the unlocated batching-plant lead for an unnamed Xuanhe data-centre project. No other queue fragment has a record within 2 km (cn-north-p1 Volcano Engine Horinger lies 657 km away). Verifier re-screen on 22 October 2026 against 2026-10-22-research-thirtyseventh (551 sites, 584 projects; the thirty-fifth to thirty-seventh additions are outside China), every sources/*holds*.json file through the thirty-seventh holds and the pending queue found no new match; the 19 October official Xuanhe infrastructure scheme independently labels Wanguo (万国) gates at four points on this parcel (its north-west and north-east corners, the east side and the south side near the south-east corner).
additions.successor_review: Re-checked 22 October 2026 from fresh captures: Zhongwei NRB planning-permit list page 1 (newest entries 10 October 2026, the GDS, Volcano and infrastructure permits), planning-notice list page 1 (newest 19 October, Xuanhe infrastructure roads, then 15 October), Zhongwei EEB EIA list page 1 (newest 19 October; the 8, 12, 15 and 19 October approval attachments and the 13 October acceptance contain no data-centre item), Ningxia EEB EIA acceptance, proposed-approval and approval lists (newest 20 October: a chemical project; the 13 October proposed approval is the Xutao 330 kV grid project) and the Zhongwei government news lists to 20 October (the 8 September cluster meeting names no project). No later permit, construction, completion or operation record for A-zone Phase 1 was found; keep 30 September 2026 as the permit observation.

status.summary: On 30 September 2026 the Zhongwei Natural Resources Bureau issued the construction-project planning permit (electronic supervision no. 6405022026GG0076614) to Zhongwei Shuofang Xinghe Technology Co., Ltd. for Phase 1 of the Volcano Engine Ningxia Zhongwei Xuanhe Compute Centre: the C1 and C2 super-core (data machine-room) buildings, auxiliary building, main gatehouse, fire-water pool and CG1/2 super-core diesel platforms (20,982.59 m2 GFA), published as in effect on 10 October 2026. The same-day land-use permit gives 42,587 m2 of land, 2,988 planned racks and 7.47 MW planned IT power. No construction start, completion or operation is established; the operations building and laboratory in the August scheme are not in this permit.
status.permit_reference: Zhongwei Natural Resources Bureau construction-project planning permit, electronic supervision no. 6405022026GG0076614, issued 2026-09-30 (post-issuance notice index 640501011/2026-00798, 2026-10-10); land-use planning permit 6405022026YG0027631 issued 2026-09-30 (index 640501011/2026-00793)
status.permit_identity_review: The permit names 火山引擎宁夏中卫宣和算力中心一期项目 and its C1/C2 super-core buildings with Zhongwei Shuofang Xinghe Technology Co., Ltd. as builder, at Xuanhe Town bounded east by Sandang Highway and north by planned Weisi Road; the land-use permit for the same project (42,587 m2, one operations building and two data machine-room buildings, 2,988 racks, 7.47 MW IT) and the August scheme for parcel 卫地(G)[2026]-29 (4.2587 ha, the same boundaries, VOLCANO ENGINE renderings) describe the same land. The super-core buildings are the data machine-room buildings, so the permit authorises the data-centre buildings themselves. Validity is marked effective; no suspension or appeal was found.

locator.precision: Area centroid of the 4.2587 ha parcel 卫地(G)[2026]-29: the land line on the official August scheme board, scaled to the permit land area (42,587 m2), rotated by the board north arrow (checked against the Weisi Road and Sandang Highway edges within 2 deg) and placed in the north-east corner of the Weisi Road/Sandang Highway block of the official Xuanhe detailed plan, itself registered to Esri World Imagery (about 5 m RMS image-to-image). Locates the Phase 1 compute-centre parcel (about 280 x 190 m, centroid about 176 m south-west of the corner); not a building footprint, entrance, surveyed boundary or construction extent.
locator.identity_review: The permits bound the land by Sandang Highway (east) and planned Weisi Road (north) at Xuanhe Town. On the official Xuanhe detailed plan, the only land west of Sandang Highway with Weisi Road on its north is the block between Weisi and Wanyun Roads, so the parcel takes that block's north-east corner; the scheme board shows the land line along 纬四路 with a chamfer at the 三党公路 corner. The 19 October official infrastructure scheme independently labels the ByteDance (Volcano Engine's parent) gate on the south side of 纬四路 just west of 三党公路, at a dashed parcel outline, and its design levels there (1367.9-1370.4 m) match the board spot heights (1366-1372 m). The permit notices print a real-estate unit in the West Cloud Base cadastral zone (640502102227GB00383W), which contradicts their own Xuanhe location text, the project name and the elevations (the West Cloud Base lies near 1298 m, about 32 km away); the code is recorded as an anomaly and not used. Volcano Engine is named in the official project title and board renderings; the permit holder is Zhongwei Shuofang Xinghe Technology Co., Ltd., and no Volcano Engine disclosure naming this campus was found.
locator.uncertainty_reason: No coordinates, datum or survey accuracy are published for the parcel. The point combines a manually read scheme outline scaled by the stated area, a north-arrow rotation, a manually picked block corner on a 6.5 m per px planning raster and that raster's registration to Esri World Imagery of unstated date and accuracy; it also assumes the parcel fills the block corner. Estimated within roughly 60 m; decimal places are arithmetic precision.
